SELECT array_agg(a.id*100+b.id ORDER BY a.id,b.id) FILTER (WHERE a.v=b.v)::text AS eq,array_agg(a.id*100+b.id ORDER BY a.id,b.id) FILTER (WHERE a.v<b.v)::text AS lt,array_agg(a.id*100+b.id ORDER BY a.id,b.id) FILTER (WHERE a.v<=b.v)::text AS le,array_agg(a.id*100+b.id ORDER BY a.id,b.id) FILTER (WHERE a.v IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.v)::text AS same FROM cm_oidvector a CROSS JOIN cm_oidvector b

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.v=a.v IS FALSE) AS nonreflexive,count(*) FILTER (WHERE (a.v=b.v) IS DISTINCT FROM (b.v=a.v)) AS asymmetric,count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.v<b.v AND b.v<c.v AND NOT a.v<c.v) AS nontransitive FROM cm_oidvector a CROSS JOIN cm_oidvector b CROSS JOIN cm_oidvector c
